# Cris Santos Company | Defense Industrial Base | Multi-Sector

> Cris Santos Company Holdings, Inc. is a publicly traded, diversified enterprise with 45,000 employees. Its Defense Industrial Base division, the focus of this scenario, operates as an aircraft parts manufacturer holding DoD subcontracts with CUI. The company also runs divisions in NAICS 54 Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services and NAICS 51 Information.

This folder is a self-contained scenario. Read this page first, then open any project folder (P01-P10). Each project folder has a `_context.md` explaining what that deliverable looks like for this company.

## What the business handles
- **Sensitive data:** Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) / Covered Defense Information; Controlled Technical Information; Federal Contract Information (FCI); ITAR technical data; EAR-controlled technology; Classified information (NISPOM)
- **Critical systems:** CUI enclaves / GCC-High or FedRAMP Moderate cloud; PLM/CAD and engineering data repositories; MES and CNC/additive manufacturing; ERP (e.g., DCAA-compliant accounting); Classified information systems; Test and evaluation systems

## Who regulates it
SRMA: Department of Defense (DoD); DoD CIO - CMMC Program Management Office; Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA) - NISPOM; State Department DDTC (ITAR); Commerce BIS (EAR)

| Requirement | Citation | Size thresholds / exemptions |
|---|---|---|
| [DFARS 252.204-7012 Safeguarding Covered Defense Information and Cyber Incident Reporting](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-48/section-252.204-7012) | 48 CFR 252.204-7012 (MAY 2024) | No small-business exemption; flowdown required to subcontracts involving CDI/operationally critical support, including commercial products/services. |
| [CMMC Program rule (32 CFR Part 170) + DFARS CMMC acquisition rule (DFARS 252.204-7021)](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2025/09/10/2025-17359/defense-federal-acquisition-regulation-supplement-assessing-contractor-implementation-of) | 32 CFR Part 170 (FR Doc. 2024-22905, Oct. 15, 2024); 48 CFR 204.75 and 252.204-7021 (NOV 2025) (FR Doc. 2025-17359, Sep. 10, 2025, DFARS Case 2019-D041) | No size exemption. Applies to solicitations/contracts above the micro-purchase threshold, except those exclusively for COTS items (32 CFR 170.3(c)). Level set by DoD per contract (FCI -> L1; CUI -> L2; high-priority CUI -> L3). Conditional status valid 180 days; final L1 1 year, L2/L3 3 years. |
| [DFARS 252.204-7019/7020 NIST SP 800-171 DoD Assessment (SPRS)](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-48/section-252.204-7020) | 48 CFR 252.204-7019 and 252.204-7020 (NOV 2023) | No size exemption; excludes COTS-only acquisitions. |
| [FAR 52.204-21 Basic Safeguarding of Covered Contractor Information Systems](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-48/section-52.204-21) | 48 CFR 52.204-21 (NOV 2021) | No size exemption; clause excluded only for COTS item acquisitions. For DoD contracts, CMMC Level 1 (Self) verifies these 15 requirements. |
| [ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations)](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-22/chapter-I/subchapter-M) | 22 CFR Parts 120-130 (registration 22 CFR 122.1; encrypted-data carve-out 22 CFR 120.54(a)(5)) | No size threshold; one occasion of manufacturing/exporting triggers registration. |
| [EAR (Export Administration Regulations)](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-15/subtitle-B/chapter-VII/subchapter-C) | 15 CFR Parts 730-774 (encrypted-data carve-out 15 CFR 734.18(a)(5)) | No size threshold. |
| [NISPOM (National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual)](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-32/part-117) | 32 CFR Part 117 (cyber incident reporting 117.8(f)) | None. |

Whether each requirement applies at this size is decided in P03 (gap analysis), step 1.

## The 10 projects for this company
| # | Project | What it covers here |
|---|---|---|
| P01 | [Risk Register](P01_risk-register/_context.md) | Group and division registers. Division registers roll up to group ERM. |
| P02 | [System Security Plan (SSP)](P02_system-security-plan/_context.md) | One system per division or a shared corporate system. SSP with common controls inherited from corporate. System: CUI engineering enclave (CAD/PLM). |

| P07 | [Security Control Assessment](P07_control-assessment/_context.md) | Common controls plus division samples. Assess common controls once; sample division controls. |
| P08 | [Incident Response Runbook](P08_incident-response-runbook/_context.md) | Incident spanning divisions. Notification matrix across all division regulators. Incident: Exfiltration of Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI). |
| P09 | [SOC 2 Readiness Checklist](P09_soc2-readiness/_context.md) | Service lines per division. Scoping decisions per division. |
| P10 | [AI Governance Risk Assessment](P10_ai-governance/_context.md) | Group AI governance program. Group standards; division use cases; regulator-specific rules. AI use case: Generative AI assistant used with CUI engineering documents. |
